XtreamServerUrlHelp: For example http://provider.example:8080. You can also paste the full M3U link (get.php?username=...&password=...) and the username and password will be filled in for you.
XtreamStreamFormatHelp: MPEG-TS is the most compatible. Use HLS only if your provider requires it.
XtreamCategoriesHelp: Tick the categories to import. Leave all unticked to import every channel. Use Test connection to load the list.
XtreamImportGuide: Import guide data from the provider
XtreamImportGuideHelp: Uses the provider's programme guide for these channels, so no separate guide provider is needed.
XtreamGuideXmltv: XMLTV file (recommended, one download for all channels)
XtreamEnableCatchupHelp: Lists channels with a TV archive in the "IPTV Catch-up" channel so past programmes can be played.
XtreamCatchupMaxDaysHelp: Limited by what the provider keeps. 0 uses the plugin-wide setting.
XtreamConfigIntro: Add a provider under Live TV > TV Sources > Add and choose "Xtream Codes (IPTV)". The settings below apply to all Xtream sources.
XtreamEpgCacheHoursHelp: How long a downloaded guide is reused before it is fetched again.
XtreamGuideDaysHelp: How many days of guide data are imported.
